capabilities.label: Web UI
capabilities.boundary: Repository contains React web UI; deployment availability must be checked separately.

capabilities.label: 3D Mother
capabilities.boundary: GLB presence is not proof of successful runtime rendering; retain 2D/text fallback.

capabilities.label: Ori Digital Avatar video
capabilities.boundary: Creator-supplied HeyGen video is a verified external media reference; this does not mean the biological Ori or that a live avatar runtime is deployed.

capabilities.label: Browser text-to-speech
capabilities.boundary: Depends on browser speechSynthesis support; not bidirectional live voice.

capabilities.label: Localized UI
capabilities.boundary: Hebrew-first; language labels do not prove complete translations.

capabilities.label: Live voice and vision
capabilities.boundary: No verified provider-backed bidirectional voice/vision deployment.

capabilities.label: Authenticated cross-device memory
capabilities.boundary: Installation continuity is not authenticated account synchronization.

capabilities.label: General computer use
capabilities.boundary: No verified deployed general-purpose computer-use agent.

capabilities.label: Image/video generation
capabilities.boundary: No verified live generation provider in public product.

capabilities.label: Store payments
capabilities.boundary: Catalog-only; no checkout or automatic purchase.

capabilities.label: Always-on autonomous agent
capabilities.boundary: Scheduled workflows do not prove continuously running autonomous execution.

capabilities.label: Universal Conversation & Interaction Memory
capabilities.boundary: Consent-gated user-scoped memory is implemented in the runtime code, but live deployment and end-to-end runtime verification remain required.

capabilities.label: Trend-to-Brand Engine
capabilities.boundary: Public-evidence research and opportunity scoring are implemented; live discovery, multi-source evidence and production verification remain required.

capabilities.label: User Growth Measurement
capabilities.boundary: Event instrumentation exists, but a connected first-party analytics property with real data is not yet verified.
